name: Gastroenteritis
symptoms: Nausea, Vomiting, Watery diarrhea, Abdominal cramps, Low fever
diet_to_eat: Bananas, Rice, Applesauce, Toast (BRAT diet), Clear broths
diet_to_avoid: Dairy products, Caffeine, Alcohol, Nicotine, Highly seasoned foods
safe_tip: ip small amounts of water or oral rehydration solutions (ORS) constantly to avoid dehydration.
dangerous_myth: Myth: Starving yourself cures stomach flu. Fact: You need electrolytes and small amounts of simple starches to heal.
